reviews.text: Internet Computer (ICP) is a blockchain platform by DFINITY for hosting web-speed dApps without traditional servers. Launched in 2021, it uses canister smart contracts for scalable Web3. In 2025, it has AI integrations and enterprise adoption. The token is used for governance and fuel. It’s ambitious but has had price volatility.

The Internet Computer (ICP) aims to be a decentralized world computer that can host web services and smart contracts natively on-chain. In late 2025 DFINITY (the company owning the protocol) moved into AI, launching Caffeine, an AI platform for building apps using natural language prompts. ICP is known for its unique cryptography and on-chain AI capabilities and has been labeled as the first blockchain to run neural network models as smart contracts. ICP’s ecosystem still remains small compared to its original ambitions and many feel that the price and the adoption have not followed its technology hype.

Internet computer is a high speed layer 1 Blockchain that uses a modified, multi-layered Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) consensus protocol known as Threshold Relay combined with Chain-Key Cryptography. The protocol is built using Web assembly (WASM) runtime which supports multiple programming languages including Motoko, Rust and Python. On internet Computer, smart contracts are called Canisters, which are a bundle of code and state that functions like a small, decentralized, tamper-proof server. Instead of users paying gas fees like in other Blockchains, here the validator pays the gas fees through the Reverse Gas Model. The chain-key on protocol allows it to have Cross-Chain Integrations with Ethereum and Bitcoin. There is a plan for expanding the integration to Solana and Doge. Internet Computer was founded by an experienced team Dfinity backed by top tier VCs like a16z, Polychain Capital and Multicoin Capital with $165 Million through several rounds. The protocol has strong partnership with giant web2 firms firms like Microsoft Azure and  Google Cloud in addition to UNDP. Moreover, the Internet Computer has taken strong security measures including multiple third party audits and an active Bug Bounty Program. However, complexity, governance concerns and high competition from established other L1 protocols.  In my opinion, the project has good potential.

Internet Computer ICP is such a wild idea it’s literally trying to run websites and apps on a blockchain. On one hand, that’s super ambitious and technically cool; the idea that you can store your code and data without giving up control is unique. But I’ve also seen its token crash and heave criticism for not delivering yet. In everyday terms, it feels like an overhyped project to me; I admire the vision, but I share concerns that it over promised.

I reviewed the Internet Computer (IC), a groundbreaking blockchain project launched by the DFINITY Foundation, designed to extend the functionality of the internet and enable the creation of decentralized web applications. Since its launch in 2021, the IC aims to reimagine the internet by replacing traditional IT infrastructure with a decentralized network of independent data centers. Its innovative approach leverages blockchain technology to scale dApps efficiently while supporting high speed, low cost computation. The project has garnered interest from developers aiming to build a more open, secure, and efficient internet, though it still faces challenges in adoption and mainstream recognition.
